newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: VA Tech's VAI 1996 pretax profit up 27 pct.
newsitem.headline: VA Tech's VAI 1996 pretax profit up 27 pct.

text.p: Austria's Voest-Alpine Industrieanlagenbau (VAI), a subsidiary of VA Tech, said on Tuesday pretax profit jumped 27 percent in 1996 as the order backlog surged 31 percent from the previous year.
Pretax profit rose to 631 million schillings from 496 million while the order backlog reached 29.4 billion after 22.4 billion in 1995, VAI said in a statement.
The company turned in a record order intake of 14.6 billion schillings, up 59 percent on the year before.

"VAI was able to continue its successful business activities as one of the world's leading metallurgical plant builders," the company said, adding turnover plus changes in inventory rose 40 percent to around nine billion schillings.
VAI builds metallurgical plants and supplies systems for both individual and integrated plants. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 531 12256
